name: User
description: Store user information for all system users including customers, agents, and managers

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for authentication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: customer, agent, or manager

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department affiliation for agents and managers

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.role: Must be one of: customer, agent, manager

name: Category
description: Define ticket categories for routing and organization with associated routing rules and default priority levels

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Category name (e.g., Technical, Billing, General Inquiry, Bug Report)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what this category covers

fields.name: defaultPriority
fields.description: Default priority level for tickets in this category (low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: routingRules
fields.description: JSON string containing routing rules for automatic ticket assignment

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this category is currently active and available for selection

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the category was created

name: Ticket
description: Central data model storing support ticket information from submission to closure with complete lifecycle tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique ticket identifier

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Ticket priority level: low, medium, high, urgent

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status: New, In Progress, Resolved, Closed

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to ticket category

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: Reference to assigned support agent user

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when ticket was created

name: Comment
description: Store all comments and updates made on tickets including agent notes, customer responses, and status changes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this comment belongs to

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: content
fields.description: The message content of the comment

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Visibility flag - true for internal notes, false for public comments visible to customers

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is authored by one user

indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order
Optimize queries for comments by a specific author

name: Attachment
description: Store file attachments associated with tickets including metadata, storage location, and security controls

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the attachment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this attachment belongs to

fields.name: commentId
fields.description: Reference to the comment if attached to a specific comment

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: mimeType
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

fields.name: storagePath
fields.description: Storage location reference or URL where the file is stored

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded

relationships.description: Each attachment belongs to one ticket
Each attachment may belong to one comment

constraints.allowedMimeTypes: Restrict to safe file types (images, PDFs, documents)
constraints.virusScan: All uploads must pass virus scanning before storage

name: TicketAssignment
description: Records all ticket assignments including agent assignments, reassignments, and queue transfers with timestamps and assignment types for workload tracking and reporting

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the assignment record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket being assigned

fields.name: assignedToUserId
fields.description: Reference to the user/agent assigned to the ticket

fields.name: assignedByUserId
fields.description: Reference to the user who made the assignment

fields.name: assignmentType
fields.description: Type of assignment: manual, automatic, escalation, or reassignment

fields.name: assignedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the assignment was made

fields.name: unassignedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the assignment ended (null if currently assigned)

fields.name: assignmentReason
fields.description: Reason or notes for the assignment or transfer

relationships.description: Each assignment belongs to one ticket
Each assignment is assigned to one user/agent
Each assignment is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_ticket_assignment_ticket
indexes.description: Index for retrieving assignment history by ticket

indexes.name: idx_ticket_assignment_user
indexes.description: Index for finding active assignments by user

indexes.name: idx_ticket_assignment_type
indexes.description: Index for reporting on assignment types

constraints.unassignedAtValidation: unassignedAt must be null or greater than assignedAt

name: NotificationLog
description: Track all email notifications sent by the system with audit trail for debugging and compliance

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification log entry

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the related ticket

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the notification recipient

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., ticket_created, ticket_assigned, status_changed, comment_added)

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Delivery status of the notification (sent, failed, pending)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: Error details if delivery failed

relationships.description: Each notification log entry is associated with one ticket

name: TicketMetrics
description: Store aggregated metrics for reporting and analytics on ticket performance, agent statistics, and SLA compliance

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the metrics record

fields.name: metricType
fields.description: Type of metric (resolution_time, first_response_time, agent_performance, category_volume, sla_compliance)

fields.name: periodStart
fields.description: Start date of the aggregation period

fields.name: periodEnd
fields.description: End date of the aggregation period

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: Reference ID for the entity being measured (userId for agents, categoryId for categories, null for global metrics)

fields.name: metricValue
fields.description: Calculated metric value (time in minutes, count, or percentage)

fields.name: ticketCount
fields.description: Number of tickets included in this metric calculation

fields.name: calculatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the metric was calculated
